description_en: Settings the security groups in the whitelist of a Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) instance
description_zh: 设置云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例白名单中的安全组
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore modify-security-group-configuration --db-instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --security-group-id sg-bpcfmyiu4ekp0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifySecurityGroupConfiguration

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the security groups that you want to set. You can specify up to 10 security group IDs, separated by commas (,).
This operation overwrites the existing settings. For valid values, query the basic information about the security groups that you created by calling DescribeSecurityGroups (https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/Ecs/2014-05-26/DescribeSecurityGroups)
parameters.help_zh:
待设置的安全组ID。最多可传入10个，安全组ID之间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
将覆盖原设置，取值参考查询您创建的安全组的基本信息DescribeSecurityGroups (https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/Ecs/2014-05-26/DescribeSecurityGroups)
parameters.name: security_group_id
